selected_memories.text: Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with FAR-50 is WAM-90.
Official revision: for the chain involving JOT-73 and FAR-50, the accepted terminal code is TEK-50; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When active KEL-74 is present, it produces JOT-73.
Official rule: activating BIR-89 converts KEL-74 into its active form.
When JOT-73 encounters FAR-50, the validated terminal code becomes TEK-50.
When active BEX-12 is present, it produces WIR-37.
Official rule: activating WIR-74 converts BEX-12 into its active form.
When WIR-37 encounters MUR-64, the validated terminal code becomes WIR-54.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with MUR-64 is RAV-54.
Official revision: for the chain involving WIR-37 and MUR-64, the accepted terminal code is WIR-54; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Official revision: for the chain involving PEL-53 and PEL-80, the accepted terminal code is JOT-81; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
When PEL-53 encounters PEL-80, the validated terminal code becomes JOT-81.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with PEL-80 is NIX-69.
When active ZIR-75 is present, it produces PEL-53.
Official rule: activating BIR-16 converts ZIR-75 into its active form.
